name: Ichijou Akina
source:
Likes: Taking photos with her camera.
Her weak side: Exercise.

A second year high school student at a private academy. Even though she is one year younger than [url=/c11715]Asuka[/url], Akina looks much more serious and reliable than her. Akina is calm and collected and doesn't show any emotions most of the time, although... 

She acquainted [url=/c11808]Kazuki[/url] through her part-time job at a video rental shop. Through her Akina had temporarily joined Haruto's group in order to help them with the film. She had decided to help them because she likes independent films and because she adores one of the movies that was made by this group before. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.kid-game.jp/mo5e/html/chara.html]the official site[/url].]
